about: Why a moving platform is paused: a bit mask maintained by esv::platform::MovementSystem::ProcessPlatformPauseReasons (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x648850), which ORs in bit 1 and bit 2 for different conditions (combat / turn-based checks of the queried components) and tests them. Seen.py context: trigger S_UND_KethericCity_Firewall_EventTrigger_2 and a trader scene.

evidence.says: ProcessPlatformPauseReasons: sets bit 0 (ORs 1 into the 64-bit value) and, elsewhere, bit 1 (ORs 2), and tests bit 0 / bit 1 of the low byte on the 8-byte-stride component storage. macOS default ctor zeroes one qword. Live 1.

open_questions: Names of the individual reason bits.
